model.name: TrainCore AI
model.type: Python local Random Forest workout recommendation model
model.training_method: A Random Forest regressor is trained from expert-rule labels over profile/exercise pairs with held-out profile validation; hard injury and location filters remain outside the model

training_type: scikit-learn Random Forest training, held-out profile evaluation, and plan-contract validation

random_forest.label_source: expert-rule suitability scores, not measured fitness outcomes

notes: TrainCore AI evaluates learned Random Forest trees locally.
The forest learns exercise suitability from expert-rule labels, not observed fitness outcomes.
Hard injury and location filters remain outside the forest.
The PHP backend only calls the Python model and stores the generated plan.
